description: Perigee is a student team that turns messy data into tools people actually use. We work in Python, web apps, data analysis, and machine learning. For Space Apps, we’re building a public tool that lets anyone watch SPHEREx sky images change over time, spot what moved, and see what an asteroid is made of from its infrared colors. We’re competing virtually through Chicago and plan to ship a working demo. Into coding, data viz, design, or astronomy? Request to join!
